messages:
Mikaela: T-minus 12m to prod traffic shift — starting standby rollforward tactical sweep. I'll run through pin + rollback readiness now. Reply with :white_check_mark: when you confirm your area.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated for release/2026-03-21-01. 3 canary pods spun up in eu-west-1. CI build 2026.03.21-01

Alvaro: Release notes posted: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-21-01 — highlights: caching fix, batcher tuning. :eyes:

Sam_tm: Model-serving pinned to v2.8.1 for prod. Pin TTL: 4h. :white_check_mark:

Julia: DB migration is no-op (index add background). Verified migration plan. Migration started on canaries 5m ago, no schema lock.

Mikaela: Rollback thresholds we agreed: 5xx rate > 0.8% for >5m OR p50 latency increase >200ms sustained 5m. Confirmed?

Eric_oncall: Watching infra. I'll alert at first sign of >0.4% 5xxs. Set pager threshold accordingly. :mag:

Sam_tm: Rollback script available:
```
./ops/rollback.sh --tag release/2026-03-21-01 --force
```
We've tested in staging. Also have hot-unpin: `deploy-bot unpin service model-serving`

deploy-bot: Pin recorded: model-serving@v2.8.1 by Sam_tm (ts=3308879000). Canary metrics: 5xx=0.03%, p50=86ms, p95=210ms.

Julia: Canary probes green. Memory stable. No GC spikes.

Alvaro: Observability checklist: dashboards pinned — open: /dash/rollout/2026-03-21. Synthetic smoke URL posted in release notes.

Release-czar: Signed off on customer comms. Opt-out window closes T-2m.

Mikaela: Ok let's hold at T-3m. No post-merge PRs in the next 3m. If any dev pushes, tag me. Oncall Eric — escalate to SRE if 5xx > 0.5%.

Eric_oncall: Ack. I'll DM SRE rotate if >=1%.

Sam_tm: If we need to rollback, will we revert the pin or run rollback script? Preference: run rollback script to keep pins intact.

Mikaela: Agreed — run rollback script first. If that fails, unpin and roll back manually.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic shifted to 30% (time=3308881250). Monitoring.

Alvaro: Quick note — worker batch window set to 200ms earlier. Keep an eye on queueing delays.

Mikaela: Final checks: 1) release notes link (ok), 2) rollback script (ok), 3) pins (ok), 4) observability dashboards (ok), 5) customer comms (ok). If no objections, proceed to traffic shift at T0.

Julia: :white_check_mark:

Sam_tm: :white_check_mark:

Eric_oncall: :white_check_mark: monitoring live.

Mikaela: Proceeding to full rollout in 2m unless any flags. I'll post another update at T0. Thanks team.
